player module¶

Player class definition for Cluedo game.

class player.Player(name: str, character: str)¶

Bases: object

Represent a Cluedo player with state and game actions.

Track a player’s name, character token, board position, card hand, notesheet, active status, and whether they may suggest without moving.

Attributes:

name: The player’s entered name. character: The Cluedo suspect token they are playing as. position: Current board position, either a corridor

coordinate tuple, a room name string, or None before setup.

hand: List of Card objects dealt to the player. notes: Dict mapping card name to who showed it, used as

the player’s CLUE sheet.

is_active: False after the player makes a wrong accusation. can_suggest_without_moving: True if this player’s token

was moved into a room by another player’s suggestion, allowing them to suggest without rolling first.

Public methods:

record_seen_card: Record a card and who showed it. show_matching_card: Return a matching card from hand. move_to: Move the player token to a new position.

move_to(new_position: tuple | str | None) → None¶

Move the player token to new_position.

Args:
new_position: A corridor coordinate tuple, a room name

string, or None to remove the player from the board.

record_seen_card(card: str, shown_by: str) → None¶

Record a card that has been seen and who showed it.

Do nothing if the card is already recorded, so that earlier entries such as own hand are not overwritten by later ones.

Args:

card: The name of the card that was shown. shown_by: Description of the source, e.g. a player’s

name, ‘own hand’, or ‘face-up’.

show_matching_card(cards: list) → str | None¶

Return a card name from hand that matches the suggestion.

If no cards match, return None. If exactly one card matches, return it automatically. If multiple cards match, prompt this player to choose which one to reveal.

Args:
cards: List of up to three card names from the current

suggestion (suspect, weapon, room).

Returns:

The name of the card to show, or None if no match.
